clips.caption: [video · 22s · 4 frames sampled] Rear view of a player in a red FC Bayern München home kit with white trim and white squad number 14 (name visible on shirt). Match action scene on a stadium pitch (celebration/interaction after play), Bundesliga sleeve badge and club crest visible; no sponsor logos clearly shown. Still frame of two players on the pitch after play, not active match action. Foreground player wears a red shirt and shorts with white trim and three white shoulder stripes; partial squad number "4" visible on the back and a Bundesliga sleeve patch; Allianz advertising and a packed stadium (Allianz Arena) visible in the background. Close-up of a player in a red home kit with white trim and three white shoulder stripes, wearing a sleeve Bundesliga badge and a white sponsor logo on the chest; no visible squad number. Still/celebration on the pitch in a stadium after a goal, with FC Bayern München branding visible on-screen and crowds in the stands. Close-up of a player in a red shirt with white vertical brushstroke trim and white Adidas stripes; large white "T" sponsor logo visible on the chest. Match-action still taken on the pitch at a stadium touchline (players walking/celebrating), no squad number visible on the foreground player.
